BiblicalUsage: Meleketh is a queen, but in Jeremiah the word belongs to one queen only, the queen of heaven. Jeremiah 7:18 shows whole families at work for her, children gathering wood, fathers kindling fire, women kneading dough to make cakes for her. Jeremiah 44:17 has the people vow to keep burning incense to her as their fathers did, and Jeremiah 44:18 and Jeremiah 44:19 record their excuse: since they left off, they have wanted all things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the queen of heaven shows how idolatry works: it is a family trade, passed down, and its worshippers credit it with every full cupboard. My position is that plenty is no proof of God's blessing when the plenty came from bowing to a false queen.
